stem.en: Rahul adds the Paris-to-France arrow to Cairo, and Egypt comes out on top. Before he says that the arrow found Egypt, what should he check?

text.en: Whether the drawn arrow ends right beside Egypt
Whether Egypt's token id comes just after Cairo's
Which word is nearest to Cairo with no arrow at all
Whether the same sum gives Egypt when run once more

explanation.en: The start word may already sit nearest to the answer, so always compare with doing nothing. The drawn arrow is a flat shadow, so it proves nothing. A sum gives the same result each time, and token ids say nothing about meaning.
